conflicts: quarantine all parts with conflicting same-time snapshots
target: calendar D+3 final ERP daily order plan
selection: three purged outer folds of four dates; five-date inner validation; refit on labels strictly before outer origin
holdout: last seven target dates, retrospective and previously observed, not new independent evidence
related_candidates: train-only positive Pearson, >=7 shared days, top3; candidate not verified BOM
cold_start: Last Value fallback, counted in all comparisons
calibration: CV residuals only; never optimize using retrospective labels
